title: Install check without the FPVBuddy app
goal: CI proves a consumer can install and import the core without the app
acceptance: CI packs the package and installs it into a throwaway consumer that imports the public API
The check fails if the package pulls in Angular or app code
privacy: Battery test data is invented; no pilot or personal data.
escalation: A package layout or publishing choice that changes how consumers install the core goes to the owner first

prs.note: standalone npm pack + throwaway consumer install check and Angular/app leak guard in CI

effort.basis: Implemented 2026-11-26 in PR #21; verification is green CI on PR #21 and merge.
